messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Error in marprobs[leftright_nodes_matrix[, 2], ] : subscript out of bounds
parts:
Hi -- your files worked fine for me.  If you are using a PC (I used a macbook air just now), sometimes they are a little more sensitive to precision issues, and sometimes raising the min on "d" and "e" from say 0.00000000000001 to 0.0001 can help -- a precision underflow can create negative probabilities and then crashes with NaNs etc. which may be what you got.

I'm attaching the results I got as a zipfile...

Cheers, Nick

PS: Thanks for using the Google Group!
